nodeCIDRMaskSizeIPv4.title: nodeCIDRMaskSizeIPv4
nodeCIDRMaskSizeIPv4.description:
The IPv4 per-node pod CIDR mask size, i.e. the size of the pod CIDR allocated to each node, from the IPv4 pod subnet.
The default is 24.
Must be between 1 and 32.
nodeCIDRMaskSizeIPv4.markdownDescription:
The IPv4 per-node pod CIDR mask size, i.e. the size of the pod CIDR allocated to each node, from the IPv4 pod subnet.
The default is `24`.
Must be between 1 and 32.

nodeCIDRMaskSizeIPv6.title: nodeCIDRMaskSizeIPv6
nodeCIDRMaskSizeIPv6.description:

The default is 64.
Must be between 1 and 128.
